reference.remaining_exact_check: Sechs fehlende Inputgruppen beschaffen: Befehle/CWD, Configpaar, Streams/Exit/Imports, Run-/Generationbasis/Namen, Sidecars/Staging, minimale Pfadtopologie. Erst danach Moduswechsel und identische Auswahl reproduzieren.
reference.scope: Independent read-only P2 review; specific later qualified remediation/audit evidence takes precedence where separately bound.

cards.read_warning: Historical review_limits/source_locations and generic remaining_limits may be superseded within a separately bound later scope; read actual detail receipts before closing or rerunning.
